notes.title: Random update 1
notes.notes: This update includes the 18th class, the Astrokinetic class, which revolves around harnessing the Focus stat to use power from space and stars. The infinite dungeon is also fully functional, though it only has the minimum number of potential floors. The transcendence room, part of the growth room, is also now fully functional. This allows the player to exceed the maximum caps of their stats. This feature is completely untested, however, so function may be limited.
